record.note: The look chooser's primary's own calls in its pre-registered timing measurement: twenty fixed descriptions of towns, three times each, each answered with one listed look or none from the library's three packs; rows are its completed calls (a repair would be a call of its own; the primary needed none). The run stopped at its pre-registered bound of 120 calls with one of the primary's sixty asks not reached. The pre-registration's own rule (the longest call rounded up to the next 5 s) gives 5 s; the manifest's timeout_rule, which binds every role, gives 10 s (the longest call times two, rounded up to 5 s), and the manifest's rule governs. The three longest calls were all one description. A call past the timeout leaves the library default with no error. The fallback serves under the same timeout when the primary is withdrawn; its slowest calls in this run were longer than the primary's and are cut by it. Nothing else of any other model is published here.
